name: My Secret Spy Lovers
source:
Your mundane life takes an unexpected turn when your strong resemblance to a famous actress puts you in a prime position to investigate her murder. Joining forces with a private-detective-turned-spy, you aim to take on the actress’s identity and investigate her inner circle in search of her killer.

But mastering the arts of deception and infiltration isn’t the only challenge you face. The high life has its own social etiquette to maneuver through, though the benefits seem to outweigh the risks… until the attacker sets his sights on you.

The killer is still out there, and with you masquerading as his target, this attempt is sure to be just the first of many. With danger on all sides, it’s up to you to decide who to trust…

Are you ready to take on this mission?

Uncover the truth in My Secret Spy Lovers!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.spyotome]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
当你与一位著名女演员的酷似使你处于调查她谋杀案的首要位置时，你的平凡生活发生了意想不到的转变。你与一名私家侦探转型为间谍，联手调查这位女演员的身份，调查她的核心圈子，寻找凶手。

但掌握欺骗和渗透的艺术并不是你面临的唯一挑战。上流生活有其自己的社交礼仪，尽管好处似乎大于风险……直到攻击者将目光投向你。

凶手仍然在那里，而你伪装成他的目标，这次尝试肯定只是众多尝试中的第一个。危险四面八方，由你来决定信任谁……

你准备好接受这个使命了吗？

在《我的秘密间谍恋人》中揭开真相！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.spyotome]Google Play[/url]]
